51130939.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length recombinant human N-terminal His6-tagged H-PGDS expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR Analysis: SPR spectroscopy measurement was performed at 25 °C on a Biacore T-200 instrument (GE Healthcare Life Science). An anti-histidine antibody (His Capture kit, GE Healthcare Life Science) was immobilized at approximate 14,500 RU onto the sensor chip CM-5 (GE Healthcare Life Science) using the Amino Coupling Kit (GE Healthcare Life Science) according to the protocol supplied by the manufacturer. Then, Histag H-PGDS was injected and captured on the chip at approximate 900 RU using PBS(-) as the running buffer. Running buffer was replaced with an assay buffer containing 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4), 150 mM NaCl, 2 mM MgCl2, 2 mM GSH, 1% DMSO, and 0.005% Tween20. Test compounds were 2-fold serially diluted in the assay buffer and tested for binding to the captured Histag H-PGDS at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The raw data (n = 3) were processed by BIA evaluation Software (GE Healthcare Life Science). TFC-007, prepared according to JP2007-51121A, was purchased from HanChem Co., Ltd. (Daejeon, Korea) and used as a high-affinity control compound.

analyte.description: Test compounds (including TFC-007 as a high-affinity control)

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4), 150 mM NaCl, 2 mM MgCl2, 2 mM GSH, 1% DMSO, 0.005% Tween20

data_analysis.software: BIA evaluation Software (GE Healthcare Life Science)
